SELECT w_name FROM warehouse WHERE w_id=? FOR UPDATE
SELECT d_name FROM district WHERE d_w_id=? AND d_id=? FOR UPDATE
SELECT c_id,c_credit,c_data FROM customer WHERE c_w_id=? AND c_d_id=? AND c_id=? FOR UPDATE
UPDATE warehouse SET w_ytd=w_ytd+? WHERE w_id=?
UPDATE district SET d_ytd=d_ytd+? WHERE d_w_id=? AND d_id=?
UPDATE customer SET c_balance=c_balance-?,c_ytd_payment=c_ytd_payment+?,c_payment_cnt=c_payment_cnt+1 WHERE c_w_id=? AND c_d_id=? AND c_id=?
UPDATE customer SET c_data=? WHERE c_w_id=? AND c_d_id=? AND c_id=?
